findings: The 24-frame contact sheet preserves a coherent sequence from customer documents through evidence and legal assessment to human review and checklist reuse.
The law scene emphasizes the specific missing-reasons provision with its explanatory heading and legal context intact.
The draft scene keeps the assessment, unresolved questions, human-review requirement and Nothing is sent message readable.
The reuse scene explicitly distinguishes reuse of the checklist from checking the new case evidence; the emphasized item remains readable and contained.
limits: Static public follow-up using the contact sheet and three full-size frames
Not a new blind review, full-speed playback assessment, exact-pixel comparison, human approval or subjective audio review
Reviewer performed no process or file-write operations
